component.name: Keep Backup
component.summary: Back up your files and prove you can restore them

description.p: Keep Backup backs up your folders and the data of the apps you use, automatically, to a network share, a USB drive or any folder. Most backup tools tell you a backup ran; Keep Backup also tells you whether you could get your files back.

ul.li: Choose folders, application data and desktop settings; native and Flatpak apps are detected for you
Encrypted, deduplicated backups in standard BorgBackup repositories
Daily or weekly backups that run with the app closed, with older versions thinned out automatically
Integrity checks, and a recovery test that restores a file using only your passphrase
A recovery checklist, key export and paper-key unlock for restoring on a new computer
Restore to a new folder without touching your current files, or to the original place with a safety copy

description.p: Keep Backup is a front end to BorgBackup. Your backups can always be restored with the borg command alone.

screenshot.caption: See at a glance whether you can get your files back
Pick a backup, then the apps, folders or files to restore
Choose which applications to back up
Know what you need to restore on a new computer

description.p: First Flatpak release, now called Keep Backup.
